instruction: The textbook is too long to read at once. Please create separate PDFs for the first four chapters to make them more manageable. Name them '1. Symmetric matrices and adjacency of a graph.pdf', '2. Graph isomorphism.pdf', '3. Graph polynomials.pdf', and '4. Covers and Interlacing families.pdf'.

files: 1. Symmetric matrices and adjacency of a graph.pdf

metadata.explanation: Task splits first half of book. Evaluator verifies: (1) Four PDFs created, (2) Full chapter names used, (3) Page counts reasonable.

llm_judge_reasons: Semantic verification is correct: Evaluator verifies both filename existence and page count content
Coverage is complete: All 4 required PDF files are checked with proper page count requirements (ch1≥8, ch2≥8, ch3≥8, ch4≥7)
Getter logic is sound: Uses pdfinfo command to extract page counts for each PDF, returns Dict[str, int] mapping filename to page count
Metric logic is correct: Properly handles expected parameter as rules dict (not wrapped), implements comparison operators (ge/eq/le/gt/lt), and uses reasonable scoring (40% filename, 60% page count)
Data flow is valid: Getter extracts both filenames and page counts → Metric receives and correctly processes the data → Verifies instruction requirements
Parameter handling is correct: Metric correctly accesses expected.get('files') and expected.get('page_counts') directly from rules dict
Practical feasibility confirmed: pdfinfo command is available in OSWorld environment, page count extraction will work at runtime
